title: ProviderSwitch
responsibility: Wraps the switches table for storing and retrieving provider-switch records.

inputs.name: ProviderSwitch.find.adapter
inputs.description: Injected persistence adapter used to read the switches table.

inputs.name: ProviderSwitch.find.id
inputs.description: Session primary key of the provider-switch record to retrieve.

inputs.name: ProviderSwitch.findBy.adapter
inputs.description: Injected persistence adapter used to query the switches table.

inputs.name: ProviderSwitch.findBy.fields
inputs.description: Record properties passed to the adapter as matching conditions.

inputs.name: ProviderSwitch.create.adapter
inputs.description: Injected persistence adapter used to insert into the switches table.

inputs.name: ProviderSwitch.create.input
inputs.description: Session key, request id and switch-request data for the new record.

inputs.name: ProviderSwitch.update.adapter
inputs.description: Injected persistence adapter used to update the switches table.

inputs.name: ProviderSwitch.update.id
inputs.description: Session primary key of the record to update.

inputs.name: ProviderSwitch.update.input
inputs.description: Request id and/or switch-request data to replace; excludes the session key.

inputs.name: ProviderSwitch.delete.adapter
inputs.description: Injected persistence adapter used to delete from the switches table.

inputs.name: ProviderSwitch.delete.id
inputs.description: Session primary key of the record to remove.

outputs.name: ProviderSwitch.find
outputs.description: Matching provider-switch record returned by the adapter, or null when absent.

outputs.name: ProviderSwitch.findBy
outputs.description: Provider-switch records returned by the adapter for the supplied conditions.

outputs.name: ProviderSwitch.create
outputs.description: Created provider-switch record returned by the persistence adapter.

outputs.name: ProviderSwitch.update
outputs.description: Updated provider-switch record returned by the adapter, or null when absent.

outputs.name: ProviderSwitch.delete
outputs.description: Whether the persistence adapter removed a matching provider-switch record.
